optimized_model_path.logical_batch_compute: fixed-32 token feedback is sliced to the active logical batch before decoder layers; logits alone are padded back to 32 for sampling

cache_ownership.page_tables: one stable device table per layer because sliding/full block geometries differ

sampling.optimized: Sampling1D force-argmax in a separate trace with tt_out_tok equal to the persistent model token input
sampling.sampled_serving: top-k/top-p/temperature/seed tensors are explicit persistent trace inputs and their semantic values key distinct sampling traces
sampling.compatibility_mode: sampling_mode=host is explicit, eager, and may gather logits for tests; it is excluded from optimized measurements

positions.current_pos: persistent INT32 device tensor advanced with ttnn.plus_one
positions.rope_position: persistent UINT32 device tensor advanced with ttnn.plus_one

reset.reason: Reset is an explicit sequence boundary; stable addresses are required within a sequence, not across released traces.
